articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

Cambridge Japanese–English Dictionary identifies **コンビニ** as an abbreviation of **コンビニエンスストア** and defines it as a small shop selling foods and similar goods with long opening hours. The entry does not make 24-hour operation or any particular services part of the word’s definition; those depend on each shop.

#### Fuente y localizador

Cambridge University Press & Assessment. (s. f.). コンビニ. In Cambridge Japanese–English Dictionary. Cambridge University Press & Assessment. https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/japanese-english/%E3%82%B3%E3%83%B3%E3%83%93%E3%83%8B

Japanese–English dictionary entry コンビニ, lines 36–52: abbreviation of コンビニエンスストア; a small store selling food etc. with long opening hours.
